subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Our company wants to __collaborate__ with your team.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"collude"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Collude"** is the most appropriate synonym of '**Collaborate**'.
 
• The word** "collude"** means- to work together.
 
 
• **Example :** It was believed that the police and the witnesses were** colluded** in that case.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options.

 
• **Repel:** to move something away/ discourage.

 
 
• **Examples:** Like charges repel each other.
 
 
 
• **Defy:** to disobey
 
 
• **Example: **That was the first time that I defied my father when he asked me to choose my career in technical field.
 
 
 
• **Captivate: **To attract somebody's attention.
 
 
• **Example:** The people were captivated by the beauty of the actress when she appeared in the movie.
